documents.title: Commercial Lease Agreement - Suite 402 Metro Tower
documents.fullText:
COMMERCIAL PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT

THIS LEASE AGREEMENT is executed this 15th day of August, 2026, by and between:
LANDLORD: Metro Real Estate Investment Trust, a Delaware Trust ("Landlord")
TENANT: Nexus Innovations LLC, a California Limited Liability Company ("Tenant")

1. PREMISES:
Landlord leases to Tenant Suite 402, comprising approximately 3,420 rentable square feet, located in Metro Tower at 100 Main Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA.

2. TERM:
The primary lease term shall commence on November 1, 2026 ("Commencement Date") and expire on October 31, 2029 ("Expiration Date"), for a duration of 36 months.

3. RENT:
Tenant agrees to pay Base Rent of $8,750.00 per month, payable in advance on the first day of each calendar month without deduction or offset.

4. SECURITY DEPOSIT:
Concurrently with execution, Tenant deposits $17,500.00 as security for full performance.

5. INSURANCE & INDEMNIFICATION:
Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 aggregate coverage naming Landlord as additional insured.

EXECUTED AND SEALED:
Harold Metro, Managing Trustee (Metro Real Estate Trust)
Jordan K. Hayes, Chief Executive Officer (Nexus Innovations LLC)
documents.summary: Binding 36-month commercial lease agreement for Suite 402 Metro Tower between Metro Real Estate Trust and Nexus Innovations LLC, with $8,750/mo base rent and $17,500 deposit.
